gettingStarted.title: 1. Getting started
gettingStarted.intro: VITAS is a sports intelligence platform for youth football. It enables scouts, coaches and sporting directors to evaluate players with objective metrics, AI video analysis, and professional reports.

gettingStarted.tip: If you are the director of an academy, select "Academy" or "Club" as your profile type to unlock the team and multi-user features.

players.title: 2. Player management
players.intro: Players are the core of VITAS. Each player has a complete profile with personal data, performance metrics, analysis history, and their VSI score.

players.tip: Data syncs automatically with the server. If you lose connection, VITAS saves your changes locally and uploads them once you are back online.

metrics.title: 3. Metrics and VSI
metrics.intro: The VSI (VITAS Scouting Index) is each player's main score. It ranges from 0 to 100 and combines all metrics with weights adjusted by position.

metricsList.name: Speed
metricsList.desc: Quickness and acceleration on the pitch

metrics.calcText: The VSI weights the metrics according to the player's position. A center forward weighs more heavily on Shooting and Speed, while a central midfielder weighs more on Vision and Technique. The algorithm also adjusts for PHV category so as not to penalize late-maturing players.
metrics.tip: A VSI above 75 is considered outstanding for a player's age. Above 85, the player is in the top percentile of their category.

video.title: 4. AI video analysis
video.intro: VITAS analyzes match videos using two AI models: Google Gemini watches the full video, and Claude generates the structured tactical report.

steps.title: Go to the player's profile
steps.desc: Tap the player in Rankings and select 'Video Analysis'.

steps.title: Upload video
steps.desc: Drag or select an MP4 video of the match. VITAS uploads it to the cloud automatically.

steps.title: Set the context
steps.desc: Kit color, player position, competitive level. Optionally, the analysis focus.

steps.title: Run the analysis
steps.desc: The AI processes the video (1-3 minutes). You will see progress in real time.

steps.title: Review the report
steps.desc: Complete report: executive summary, KPIs, strengths, areas to improve, recommendations.

video.teamText: It works the same way but evaluates the whole team: formation, phases of play and collective metrics (compactness, synchronization, pressing). Team level only: no shirt numbers or per-player figures.
video.tip: Videos are stored securely on Bunny CDN. You can re-analyze them with different focuses (offensive, defensive, transitions) without uploading them again.

rankings.title: 5. Rankings and comparisons
rankings.intro: The Rankings view shows all your players sorted by VSI. Features:
list: Search — Filter by name in real time
Sort — By VSI, age, or name

Filter by group — Sub-14, Sub-16, Sub-18, Sub-21
rankings.compareText: From the main menu, open "Compare" to select 2 players and see their metrics radars overlaid, differences by dimension, and the AI's recommendation on which has more upside.

roleProfile.title: 6. Tactical profile (Role Profile)
roleProfile.intro: The Role Profile is an AI-generated analysis that determines the player's tactical archetype (e.g., "Dribbler", "Playmaker", "Box-to-Box") based on their metrics.
list: Optimal position — Where they perform best according to their numbers
Archetype — Dominant style of play
Identity — Breakdown: physical, technical, offensive, defensive, mixed
Projection — Not shown: there is no validated basis to project capabilities
Summary — AI-generated text with an analysis of the profile
roleProfile.tip: The Role Profile is recalculated every time you update the player's metrics. You can compare roles across players and view the history of changes.

phv.title: 7. PHV and biological maturation
phv.intro: PHV (Peak Height Velocity) measures where a youth player is in their biological development. It is crucial for not unfairly comparing an early-maturing boy with a late-maturing one.

categories.name: Early (Pre-PHV)
categories.desc: Has not yet reached their growth peak. May appear "slower" but has enormous room for physical improvement. The VSI is adjusted x1.12 to compensate.

categories.name: On-time (During PHV)
categories.desc: In the middle of the growth peak. Critical development window — training decisions here are the most important. VSI with no adjustment.

categories.name: Late (Post-PHV)
categories.desc: Has already passed their peak. More stable physical performance, but may be "inflated" vs peers. VSI is adjusted x0.92.

phv.tip: VITAS calculates PHV using the Mirwald formula, the standard in youth sports science. If you provide sitting height and leg length, the accuracy is 92%.

scoutInsights.title: 8. Scout Insights (AI)
scoutInsights.intro: Scout Insights are intelligent alerts generated automatically by VITAS's AI. They detect patterns in your players' data and produce actionable recommendations.
list: Breakout — Player with a high VSI and an upward trend
PHV Alert — Critical development window detected
Drill Record — Exceptional metric achieved

Milestone — Important milestone crossed (VSI 80, 90...)
scoutInsights.outro: Each insight includes a headline, a body with a numeric data point, recommended drills from the VITAS library, and concrete actions for the coach.

cameraAngle.title: Camera angle
cameraAngle.good: Record from an elevated position (stands, bleachers, stairs). The higher, the better the tracking.
cameraAngle.bad: Filming from the sideline at field level loses depth and players overlap each other.

distanceFraming.title: Distance and framing
distanceFraming.good: Capture at least half the field. A wide shot where several players can be seen moving.
distanceFraming.bad: Zooming in on a single player prevents calculating position, distance covered, and zones of influence.

stability.title: Stability
stability.good: Rest your phone on something fixed: tripod, railing, backpack. A stable video means accurate data.
stability.bad: Shaky video produces blurry frames that the system discards. Fewer frames means less accuracy.

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.good: Even natural light, without filming against the sun. Ideal time: morning or afternoon (not midday).
lighting.bad: Backlight or strong shadows on the field reduce player detection by up to 30%.

duration.title: Duration
duration.good: Between 2 and 5 minutes of continuous play. More time means more data means a more reliable evaluation.
duration.bad: Videos shorter than 30 seconds don't generate enough data for a useful evaluation.

verifyConsentPage.title: Legal guardian consent
verifyConsentPage.intro: The person responsible for the minor in VITAS is asking for your consent as parent or legal guardian. This is what you authorise:
verifyConsentPage.what1: Analysis of videos of training sessions and matches in which the minor appears.
verifyConsentPage.what2: Storage of the results of that analysis in their VITAS profile, managed by the responsible person.
verifyConsentPage.what3: You can withdraw it at any time with the link we will send you when you confirm.
verifyConsentPage.dniHint: A fingerprint (hash) of the ID is stored, not the number as typed. It serves as proof of who confirmed.

coachEval.label: Coach evaluation
coachEval.hint: Subjective rating: a 0-100 index of the 6 bars the coach scores. It is not a measurement and is not corrected for maturation.

glossary.long: A 0-100 index weighting the 6 bars the coach scores (speed, technique, vision, stamina, shooting and defending). It is a subjective rating: not a measurement and not corrected for maturation.

notConnected.title: The coach panel is not connected yet
notConnected.desc: It will be connected to your real training sessions. Until then no figures are shown: what was here was example data (session, progress, reports and weekly plan).

roleProjection.title: Projection at 0-6, 6-18 and 18-36 months
roleProjection.gateReason: No basis for a projection: there is no validated model of how each capability develops with age and maturation, so no future figure is shown.

videoVsiGlossary.long: A 0-100 index computed by the video analysis (AI) from what is observed in the video. It is different from the coach evaluation (its 6 bars) and is blocked when its inputs are missing.

duelsGate.reason: VITAS does not count duels: there is no validated criterion for what a duel is or who wins it (human annotation is missing). They are not inferred from proximity.

scanIqGate.reason: Scan IQ not available: there is no validated basis to score scanning by age, and video analysis does not detect ball receptions or identify the player.

dmScoreGate.reason: Decision-Making Score not available: its weights have no source and its components are not measured (Scan IQ blocked; decision speed and composure not validated; tactical reading not measured from video).
